claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: BNTX is a delta-opioid receptor antagonist with no known cytotoxic activity at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would likely reflect weak, non-selective actin-network disruption rather than opioid-receptor-mediated killing.
